 Cover Story
 Sudurpaschim, Lumbini face off for first final spot in NPL 3
 By: ApEx BUREAU 
 Published: Nov. 17, 2026, 9:38 a.m. 
 A 
 A 
 The Lumbini Lions and the Sudurpaschim Royals are playing the first qualifier match of the ongoing 3rd edition of Nepal Premier League (NPL) today.
 The match between these teams begins at 5 pm at the TU International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur.
 The winner of the match will advance to the final match. The losing team, however, gets an opportunity to reach the final match after facing the winner of the 'eliminator' round.
 Both Sudurpaschim and Lumbini are planning to secure their spot in the final on this very first attempt. Sudurpaschim are reaching the final for the third consecutive time, while Lumbini tries to make it for the second time. 
 In the final of the previous NPL, Lumbini had defeated Sudurpaschim, clinching the title.
